introHtml: BCG lanyards and badges offer a reliable, cost-effective solution for organizations needing to identify staff, manage access, or promote events. Whether you need durable woven lanyards for daily use or budget-friendly options for a one-time conference, BCG provides consistent quality and quick turnaround. Choose from a variety of widths, materials, and attachment options to match your specific needs, from the 1" Knit-In Lanyard to the 3/4" Recycled Lanyard. Perfect for schools, hospitals, and corporate offices.
